00050 #define DEFAULT_UGEN_DOCS   <I>Not yet documented although the argument name should be reasonably clear</I>.
00051 #define COMMON_UGEN_DOCS    <B>Generic %UGen argument documentation:</B>                                        \
00052                             Arguments which are UGen type can be continuously controlled and these              \
00053                             may generally be multichannel (although there are some exceptions).                 \
00054                             Arguments which are constant/literal values (e.g., float or int) are clearly        \
00055                             not continuously controllable and not multichannel (therefore will                  \
00056                             generallly be applied identically to each channel should the UGen being             \
00057                             created is made multichannel via other arguments.                                   \
00058                             Arguments which are Buffer type may require a Buffer for some specific              \
00059                             purpose (e.g, TableOsc uses a buffer for its wavetable) but single channel          \
00060                             Buffer objects are also used to specify an array of literal values (e.g., LLine)    \
00061                             \n\
00062                             \n\
